data.name: Surprise Strike
data.description: (Intermediate) When you attack an opponent that's denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, you deal %1d6 points of extra precision damage. Your target counts as flat-footed against the first attack you make against that target in a day, regardless of abilities like uncanny dodge. After your first attack, that target is immune to being made flat-footed by your surprise strike for 24 hours.|MediumLVL/3
